name: xbert-cross-sell-opportunities
description: Find your highest-value cross-sell opportunities by matching client profile to service uptake patterns.

x-xbert.tagline: Find your highest-value cross-sell opportunities by matching client profile to service uptake patterns.
prerequisites: XPM connected (for service uptake and client data)
At least 20 clients in the Connect — lookalike matching needs a reasonable peer set
x-xbert.longDescription:
Cross-sell conversations stall because the partner cannot remember which clients are obvious candidates for which service. This plugin makes that recall mechanical. Using XBert's similar-clients engine, it finds your existing book's lookalike pairs, looks at which services the lookalike has that the candidate does not, and ranks every cross-sell opportunity by inferred fit and revenue uplift potential.

The output is per-client: ranked cross-sell opportunities with the talking points already drafted. Quarterly cadence pairs naturally with the annual fee review — fee review tells you what to charge for what they have; cross-sell tells you what to offer next.

useCases.title: Quarterly client-development pass
useCases.description: Once a quarter, generate the cross-sell shortlist for every client manager so client conversations start from data, not memory.

useCases.title: Pre-meeting brief
useCases.description: Before a regular client review, run the lookalike check to surface what similar clients use that this one does not — talking points ready.

useCases.title: Service expansion planning
useCases.description: See which services are systematically under-adopted across cohorts where the lookalike pattern suggests fit — input to a campaign.

useCases.title: Onboarding follow-up
useCases.description: Three months after a new client joins, run the check to see what services their lookalike cohort uses that they have not yet adopted.

benefits.title: Lookalike-driven, not guess-driven
benefits.description: Uses XBert's similar-clients engine to find peers inside your own book. Recommendations are grounded in what your own similar clients actually use.

benefits.title: Ranked by fit and uplift
benefits.description: Every opportunity is ranked by inferred fit and revenue uplift potential, so the conversation list is naturally prioritised.

benefits.title: Talking points drafted
benefits.description: Per-client output includes drafted talking points referencing the lookalike pattern, ready for the next client conversation.

workflow: Confirm Connect tenant and cohort scope (default = whole book)
Plugin pulls client profiles, lookalike pairs, and current service uptake via XBert MCP
Per-client opportunity matrix is built and ranked
Word document is produced with per-client opportunity sheets and talking points
